text: Total net revenue for fiscal 2023 was $12,480 million, an increase of 9% compared to $11,450 million in fiscal 2022. The growth was driven primarily by higher volumes in the Automation segment and favorable pricing. Gross margin expanded to 43.2% from 41.8% in the prior year, reflecting improved manufacturing efficiency and a richer product mix.

Operating income was $2,310 million in fiscal 2023 compared to $1,980 million in fiscal 2022. Research and development expense increased 14% to $1,120 million as the company accelerated investment in its next generation motion-control platform. Cash provided by operating activities was $2,750 million.

Our results depend on a small number of large customers. In fiscal 2023, our three largest customers together accounted for 38% of total net revenue. The loss of any one of these customers, or a material reduction in their orders, could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.

Consolidated balance sheet highlights (in millions): Total current assets 9,120; Total assets 21,540; Total current liabilities 5,480; Long-term debt 4,200; Total stockholders equity 9,860. Cash and cash equivalents were 3,410 at fiscal year end 2023.
Total net revenue for fiscal 2022 was $11,450 million. Operating income was $1,980 million. The Automation segment contributed 62% of total revenue while the Services segment contributed 38%.

Revenue for fiscal 2023 rose 22% to $18,900 million, led by unprecedented demand for data-center accelerators. Data center revenue more than doubled year over year to $9,400 million. Gross margin was 61.5%, up from 58.0% in fiscal 2022, driven by product mix toward higher-margin accelerators.

A substantial portion of our manufacturing is concentrated with a single third-party foundry located in one geographic region. Any disruption to that foundry, including from geopolitical tension or natural disaster, could significantly impair our ability to meet customer demand and harm our operating results.

Selected income statement data (in millions): Revenue 18,900; Cost of revenue 7,277; Gross profit 11,623; Operating expenses 4,100; Operating income 7,523; Net income 6,180. Diluted earnings per share were 2.47 for fiscal 2023.
Revenue for fiscal 2022 was $15,490 million with a gross margin of 58.0%. Data center revenue was $4,300 million in fiscal 2022.

Net sales decreased 3% to $8,120 million in fiscal 2023 as consumer spending softened in core European markets. E-commerce penetration reached 31% of net sales. The company reduced inventory by 12% year over year to improve working capital efficiency.
Cash flow highlights (in millions): Cash from operations 640; Capital expenditures 310; Free cash flow 330; Dividends paid 210. Total debt to equity ratio was 0.85 at fiscal year end 2023.
